title: Cheap and Thin!
text:
Cheap and Thin!. [[VIDEOID:a53a14db182a45c90bd26533d2ffb474]] Not too impressed. Thin and not doubled bottom. Feels pretty cheap. Can’t see the handle joints last long.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
